identityConfidence: HIGH — 14–17 November 2024 at GKVK, Bengaluru, themed 'Climate Smart Digital Agriculture'. Around 700 stalls reported at opening, with UAS itself citing ~740 agricultural exhibition stalls erected. Opening-day footfall reported at 1.31 lakh; Deccan Herald reported the fair concluding with 54.16 lakh visitors.
